thread:
Jordan: Heads-up team  idea to run a 'Satellite Kiosk' recognition pop-up next month with an eco-friendly kit (recycled card, seed paper thank-you, enamel pin). Need logistics: volunteer training, ADA table setup, and a tiny tracking sheet. Thoughts? :seedling:
Maya: Love the seed-paper idea. Which cities and quantities?
Jordan: Plan: SF (6/7) 150, NY (6/14) 130, Amsterdam (6/21) 90, remote mailout week of 6/28 ~320. Total ~690 + buffer.
Leo: I can do SF. Suggest 30-min volunteer training before the event on kiosk etiquette, accessibility, and quick tax reminders.
Becca: Good call. Can we include a laminated FAQ card for volunteers: tax thresholds, what counts as cash-equivalent, and how to route queries to payroll?
Jordan: Yes. Draft FAQ points: 1) No cash in kits, route gift cards via payroll; 2) Items > $150 flagged for tax review; 3) If recipient asks for physical pickup, follow the pick-up checklist.
Oscar: For accessibility, reserve a lower table, provide a chair, and have a quiet spot sign people can request. I'll add that to the venue checklist.
Maya: Inventory owner? need columns: SKU, qty ordered, qty received, bin, packer initials, ship date, tax-flag. Also an "export-ready" tab for shipping label CSV.
Leo: I'll own inventory and add a "last-mile volunteer" checkbox. Also include a packer notes column for damaged items.
Jordan: Volunteer shifts: manager-only setup 08:30-09:00, public volunteers 09:00-11:30, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00. Add a volunteer role column (greeter, packer, ship-run).
Becca: Can we add a tiny ROI metric: #kits handed out vs #QR responses and optional one-line qual comment? Use tiny.redwood/kiosk?loc=SF etc.
ops_bot: Reminder: international shipments may trigger VAT depending on declared value. See policy: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/shipping-guidelines
Jordan: Good point. Keep declared values low; procurement to vet courier. Maya, can procurement get quotes for 320 remote drops and local same-day for SF/NY?
Maya: On it. I'll ping procurement and request eco-packaging options too.
Oscar: Comms: I'll draft a short blurb + event banner for each office channel. Also a volunteer guidebook (one page) and an accessibility checklist.
Leo: Training slot scheduled: Wed 6/3 10:00 PT (30min). I'll post the recording for folks who can't make it.
Becca: Inventory draft link (WIP): https://docs.redwood/spotlight/satellite-inventory (edit access for Leo, Jordan, Maya).
Jordan: Final asks: volunteers, inventory owner (Leo), procurement quote (Maya), and a post-event 3-bullet recap for All Hands. Quick check-in at next standup. Thanks! :raised_hands:
